Skills marketplaces

Agent skills from git-hosted marketplaces, installed into the folders Codex, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code read, and switched on and off

Docs / Skills marketplaces

Area
toil skills
The toil skill
toil skill

skills/toil/skills.md

A skills marketplace is a git repository of plugins, each a folder of agent skills (plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md, optionally listed in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json). toil clones it, copies plugin skills into the skills folder an agent host reads, and switches plugins on and off without deleting them. Verification level: unit.

Supported versions: git 2.24 or later. toil runs the git already on PATH to clone and pull a marketplace, and nothing else. A private marketplace needs git 2.31 or later, which takes its token from the environment rather than the command line; an older git gets GIT_NOT_FOUND saying so.

Where skills go

--agentProject scope (--scope project)User scope (--scope user, the default)
codex (the default).agents/skills~/.agents/skills
github-copilot.github/skills~/.copilot/skills
claude-code (--claude).claude/skills~/.claude/skills

.agents/skills is read by Codex and GitHub Copilot alike, which is why it’s the default. Project scope is the root of the repository the workspace is in, or the workspace outside one. --all-agents (on add and sync) installs for all three.

Each skills folder keeps an index, .toil-installed.json, recording which skills toil installed and from where; each installed skill also gets a toil-origin.json. A switched-off skill moves to .toil-disabled/ in the same folder, which agent hosts don’t read. toil replaces only skill folders it installed from the same marketplace and plugin: a folder of the same name it didn’t install is left alone, listed in failed, with a SKILLS_NOT_REPLACED warning. Symlinks in a marketplace are never copied.

Credential and configuration

Each marketplace is a connection of the skills area. toil skills marketplace add sets one up from a terminal; in CI, define one with env vars.

KeyEnv var (default connection)Meaning
repoUrlTOIL_SKILLS_REPO_URLClone URL: https://…, or a local path. ssh isn’t supported
localPathTOIL_SKILLS_LOCAL_PATHWhere the clone lives (default ~/.agents/marketplaces/<repo-name>)
branchTOIL_SKILLS_BRANCHBranch to clone (default: the remote HEAD)
usernameTOIL_SKILLS_USERNAMEUser name sent with the token (default x-access-token on GitHub, x-token-auth elsewhere; Bitbucket Data Center personal tokens usually need your username)
providerTOIL_SKILLS_PROVIDERgithub, bitbucket, ado or git, when the URL doesn’t say
tokenTOIL_SKILLS_TOKENHTTP access token for a private marketplace: a secret
writesTOIL_SKILLS_WRITEStrue lets sync, enable and disable change skills folders from this marketplace

A named connection uses TOIL_CONN_<NAME>_<KEY> instead (TOIL_CONN_CORP_SKILLS_TOKEN). A whole marketplace from env alone:

export TOIL_CONN_CORP_SKILLS_AREA=skills
export TOIL_CONN_CORP_SKILLS_REPO_URL=https://bitbucket.imagile.dev/scm/ai/skills.git
export TOIL_CONN_CORP_SKILLS_TOKEN=<token>
export TOIL_CONN_CORP_SKILLS_WRITES=true
toil skills marketplace sync all --marketplace corp-skills --allow-write

The token lives in the OS credential store (config holds only a keychain: reference) or an env var, never in the file and never on a command line. Replace it with toil connections login <name>. toil hands it to git for that marketplace’s clone and pull only, as an http.<url>.extraHeader in git’s environment, which git sends to that URL and nowhere else. With no token, git uses your own git credentials.

--marketplace <name> picks the marketplace by connection name or clone URL; without it, the area’s default (the first one added), else the only one.

Writes

Installing, refreshing and switching plugins changes files on this machine, so sync, enable and disable need "writes": true on the marketplace and --allow-write on the call. add is CLI only, needs --allow-write because it clones, and leaves writes off: adding a marketplace never grants installs from it. Turn them on as for any connection: "writes": true on it in ~/.toil/config.json, or TOIL_CONN_<NAME>_WRITES=true. remove is CLI only.

From the menu

Bare toil on a terminal opens a menu with Agent skills, which holds three things: Skill plugins (add, update and remove a marketplace, turn its writes on, install a skill plugin for the agent and place you pick, and tick which skill plugins are on; it shows the changes before running them), View installed skills, and Install the toil skill (below). Every screen runs the commands below and prints each one, so the menu writes exactly what the command would.

The toil skill itself

The skill you’re reading ships inside toil. toil skill install --allow-write writes it into one agent’s folder (--agent and --scope as above), recorded as bundled, and toil keeps it current from then on: install.md has the detail. skills status lists it with source: "bundled", and stale: true until the next run rewrites a copy another toil version wrote. Marketplace and untracked skills are never rewritten.

Commands

toil skills marketplace add <url> [localPath]

Registers a marketplace and clones it, with writes off; it installs nothing. CLI only; setup is an alias. On a terminal it asks for an access token (leave it empty for a public repository) and keeps it in the OS credential store. The first marketplace becomes the default. Adding it again keeps whatever writes you set.

toil skills marketplace add https://bitbucket.imagile.dev/scm/ai/skills.git --name corp-skills --allow-write
# then set "writes": true on corp-skills in ~/.toil/config.json, and:
toil skills marketplace sync all --marketplace corp-skills --claude --scope project --allow-write
FlagMeaning
--name <name>Its connection name (default: from the URL)
--branch <branch>Branch to clone
--username <username>User name sent with the token
--provider <provider>github, bitbucket, ado or git

Output: { name, repoUrl, localPath, branch, tokenConfigured, tokenStorage, provider, writes, cloned, available: [{ name, description }], total, next }, next saying how to turn writes on and install.

toil skills marketplace list

Every registered marketplace: { marketplaces: [{ name, repoUrl, localPath, tokenConfigured, tokenStorage, provider, username, upstreamRemote, writes }], total }. tokenStorage is keychain, env or null; the token itself is never shown. MCP tool: skills_marketplace_list.

toil skills marketplace plugins <name>

The plugins a marketplace offers, from its clone: { marketplace, plugins: [{ name, description }], total }. MCP tool: skills_marketplace_plugins.

toil skills marketplace sync [plugin]

Clones the marketplace if it isn’t yet, otherwise pulls it (fast-forward only), then installs: one plugin by name, every plugin with all, or with no plugin the ones already installed in the target folder. A switched-off plugin stays off; its stashed copy is refreshed. MCP tool: skills_marketplace_sync.

toil skills marketplace sync review --allow-write
toil skills marketplace sync all --marketplace corp-skills --claude --scope project --allow-write
FlagMeaning
--marketplace <name>Which marketplace
--agent <agent>, --claude, --all-agentsWhich agent hosts
--scope <scope>user (default) or project
--installed-onlyWith all, skip plugins not installed yet

Output: { marketplace, plugins: { <plugin>: { installed, failed } }, total, target, marketplaceUpdated }; for one plugin { marketplace, plugin, installed, failed, total, target, marketplaceUpdated }; for several agents targets.

toil skills marketplace disable <plugin>

Switches a plugin off in one skills folder: its skills move to .toil-disabled/ and their records to disabled in .toil-installed.json. Nothing else in the index changes. MCP tool: skills_marketplace_disable.

toil skills marketplace disable review --claude --allow-write

Output: { disabled, alreadyDisabled, skipped, total, target, plugin, stash, marketplace }.

toil skills marketplace enable <plugin>

Switches a plugin back on. A skill whose stashed copy has gone is listed in stashMissing, with a warning; sync <plugin> restores it. MCP tool: skills_marketplace_enable.

Output: { enabled, skipped, total, target, plugin, marketplace }.

enable and disable take --marketplace, --agent, --claude and --scope.

toil skills marketplace remove <name>

Unregisters a marketplace and deletes its token from the OS credential store. Its clone and the skills installed from it stay on disk. CLI only.

Output: { removed: { name, repoUrl, localPath }, keychainEntryDeleted, remaining }.

toil skills status

Every skill in every agent skills folder, at both scopes: { skills: [{ skill, path, agent, scope, location, enabled, source, plugin, marketplace, repoUrl, localPath, upstreamRemote, branch, installedAt, toilVersion, stale }], total, enabled, disabled, untracked, stale, toilVersion, byMarketplace, locations }. source is marketplace, bundled or untracked (a skill toil didn’t install). Filter with --marketplace, --plugin, --source, --agent and --scope. MCP tool: skills_status.

Not built yet

skills list, uninstall, locations, guide, purge-user, marketplace update (use toil connections login for a token), marketplace instructions, marketplace purge-plugin and marketplace manage (the welcome menu replaces it). skills git-auth is not coming: toil gives git a marketplace’s token per call instead of changing your git config.

Commands at a glance

  • toil skillsmarketplace syncwrite

    Clone or pull a marketplace and install its plugins into an agent skills folder: one plugin, "all", or with none the ones already installed

    MCP skills_marketplace_sync[plugin]--agent <agent>--claude--all-agents--scope <scope>--installed-only--marketplace <name>--allow-write

  • toil skillsmarketplace enablewrite

    Switch a disabled plugin's skills back on

    MCP skills_marketplace_enable<plugin>--agent <agent>--claude--scope <scope>--marketplace <name>--allow-write

  • toil skillsmarketplace disablewrite

    Switch a plugin's skills off without deleting them: they move to a hidden stash (switch back on with marketplace enable)

    MCP skills_marketplace_disable<plugin>--agent <agent>--claude--scope <scope>--marketplace <name>--allow-write

  • toil skillsmarketplace addwriteCLI onlyalso toil skills marketplace setup

    Register a marketplace and clone it, with writes off; asks for a token on the terminal (setup is an alias). Install from it with marketplace sync once writes are on

    <url>[localPath]--name <name>--branch <branch>--username <username>--provider <provider>--allow-write

  • toil skillsmarketplace list

    List all registered marketplaces

    MCP skills_marketplace_list

  • toil skillsmarketplace plugins

    List the plugins available in a registered marketplace

    MCP skills_marketplace_plugins<name>

  • toil skillsmarketplace removeCLI only

    Remove a registered marketplace from the config, and its token from the OS credential store (the local clone and installed skills are kept)

    <name>

  • toil skillsstatus

    Show every installed skill with its plugin, marketplace, and upstream remote, and whether it is on

    MCP skills_status--marketplace <name>--plugin <name>--source <source>--agent <agent>--scope <scope>

Commands at a glance

  • toil skillinstallwriteCLI only

    Install the toil skill into an agent's skills folder; toil keeps it current from then on

    --agent <agent>--claude--scope <scope>--allow-write

  • toil skillshow

    Show the toil skill: the description toil writes for this config, and every installed copy and whether it is current

    MCP skill_show
